description.en: Compress old logs, remove expired files, and report freed space
description.de: Alte Logs komprimieren, abgelaufene Dateien entfernen und freigegebenen Speicher melden

instructions.de: Bereinige Log-Dateien. Variablen: log_dir (Verzeichnis), compress_days (ältere Logs komprimieren, default 7), delete_days (ältere Logs löschen, default 30), pattern (Datei-Muster, default '*.log').
instructions.en: Clean up log files. Variables: log_dir (directory), compress_days (compress older logs, default 7), delete_days (delete older logs, default 30), pattern (file pattern, default '*.log').

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
LOG_DIR="{{ log_dir }}"
PATTERN="{{ pattern }}"
PATTERN=${PATTERN:-*.log}
COMPRESS_DAYS={{ compress_days }}
COMPRESS_DAYS=${COMPRESS_DAYS:-7}
DELETE_DAYS={{ delete_days }}
DELETE_DAYS=${DELETE_DAYS:-30}
echo "=== Log Rotation: $LOG_DIR ==="
echo "Pattern: $PATTERN | Compress after: ${COMPRESS_DAYS}d | Delete after: ${DELETE_DAYS}d"
echo ""
echo "--- Before cleanup ---"
du -sh "$LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot measure directory"
FILE_COUNT=$(find "$LOG_DIR" -name "$PATTERN" -o -name "${PATTERN}.gz" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Total log files: $FILE_COUNT"
echo ""
echo "--- Compressing old logs (>${COMPRESS_DAYS} days) ---"
find "$LOG_DIR" -name "$PATTERN" -mtime +"$COMPRESS_DAYS" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  echo "Compressing: $f"
  gzip -f "$f"
done
COMPRESSED=$(find "$LOG_DIR" -name "${PATTERN}.gz" -mtime +"$COMPRESS_DAYS" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Compressed: $COMPRESSED files"
echo ""
echo "--- Deleting old compressed logs (>${DELETE_DAYS} days) ---"
DELETED=0
find "$LOG_DIR" -name "${PATTERN}.gz" -mtime +"$DELETE_DAYS" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  echo "Deleting: $f"
  rm -f "$f"
done
echo ""
echo "--- After cleanup ---"
du -sh "$LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot measure directory"
FILE_COUNT_AFTER=$(find "$LOG_DIR" -name "$PATTERN" -o -name "${PATTERN}.gz" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Remaining log files: $FILE_COUNT_AFTER"
echo "=== Rotation complete ==="

command.de: Fasse das Log-Rotation-Ergebnis zusammen. Berichte über komprimierte und gelöschte Dateien, den freigegebenen Speicherplatz und ob die Konfiguration (compress_days, delete_days) sinnvoll erscheint. Gib Empfehlungen bei auffälligen Befunden.
command.en: Summarize the log rotation result. Report on compressed and deleted files, the freed disk space and whether the configuration (compress_days, delete_days) seems reasonable. Give recommendations for any notable findings.
